body L1-L2: the labels (ι) and (κ) are set in the type of the text, not in bold as (α) to (ϑ) on p. 153.
body L15: a speck stands under the R of «Recherches»; it is not a sign.
body L33-L34: a slanted stroke stands between the lines, from under the s of «sinum» to over the last a of «pervulgata»; it is not an accent.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
